name: Kunstinstituut Melly
known: Directors: Sofía Hernández Chong Cuy joined in January 2018 (The Art Newspaper).
Niemeijer Fonds, founded by a Groningen tobacco producer's daughter, supported a 2025 show.

name: Nederlands Fotomuseum
known: Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (OCW) and the Municipality of Rotterdam subsidised the predecessor institutes and are listed as founders and benefactors on the museum's website (Dutch Wikipedia; museum website).
Network Cultures names Wim Pijbes as its director and Martijn van der Vorm as the billionaire behind it.

name: Sonneveld House
known: Brinkman and Van der Vlugt designed it for Albertus Sonneveld, a director of the Van Nelle factory.

name: V2_ Lab for the Unstable Media
known: V2_ collaborates in projects co-funded by the Creative Europe Programme of the EU and the European Commission's Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology.
The director is F.
Brouwer as deputy; the supervisory board is U Yong Hu (chair), Jens Besse, Mieke van Heesewijk and Maaike Harbers, and it works unpaid.

name: Mauritshuis
known: Martine Gosselink has been director since February 2020 (Wikipedia).

NN Group has been "main sponsor of the Mauritshuis since 2016" and pays for the annual exhibition, the museum playlist "View the Mauritshuis with Your Ears" and the guest-director evenings Maurits&; no amount or terms are stated (NN Group website).

name: Museum Beelden aan Zee
known: Legal form: Stichting Museum Beelden aan Zee, run by a board of six unpaid members chaired by Isaäc Kalisvaart (ANBI page on the museum's website).

name: Stroom Den Haag
known: Run by a board of four and a directorate of an artistic director and a business director.
Alexandra Landré is listed as artistic director (stroom.nl).

Board (stroom.nl): Els van der Plas (chair, director of the Allard Pierson in Amsterdam), Joost Vrieler (secretary, senior policy advisor at the Province of Groningen), Peter Verbaas (treasurer, partner at Charistar BV) and Bircan Bozbey (director-manager of Trias, Centrum voor de Kunsten).

name: De Pont
known: Founded by the Stichting De Pont, a foundation set up in 1988 with part of the estate of Jan de Pont.

Director Martijn van Nieuwenhuyzen told Omroep Tilburg on 23 January 2024: "We zijn een particulier museum, dus we ontvangen geen subsidie van de gemeente" (translation: we are a private museum, so we receive no subsidy from the municipality).

Source of the wealth: De Pont practised as a lawyer in Amsterdam and advised AGAM, the Dutch importer of Mercedes-Benz, becoming acting director in 1956 and taking full control in 1960; he also advised other companies and helped restructure Tilburg textile mills (museum website).

name: BAK, basis voor actuele kunst
known: Led for 25 years by its founding director Maria Hlavajova, who stepped down on 30 June 2025.
It now runs as BAK Basecamp for Tactical Imaginaries, a collective, artist-led programme under artistic director Jeanne van Heeswijk.

name: Casco Art Institute: Working for the Commons
known: Aline Hernández (artistic director) and Marianna Takou (executive director) now govern Stichting Casco (Casco team page).

name: Centraal Museum
known: Bart Rutten is artistic director and Anastasia van Gennip business director (Dutch Wikipedia).

name: Van Schijndel House
known: Drabbe is an architecture historian and the director and founder of Iconic Houses, and DUIC reports that she lives in the house (Herenhuis 2022, DUIC 2016 and 2024).
